newsitem.title: FRANCE: French July/May wheat exports up sharply - ONIC.
newsitem.headline: French July/May wheat exports up sharply - ONIC.

text.p: French soft wheat grain exports to non-EU countries reached 5.92 million tonnes between July 1, 1996 and May 31, 1997, that is 1.8 million tonnes more than during the same period last season, national grain office ONIC said on Wednesday.
ONIC data as of June 1, 1997, showed Egypt was the main destination for French wheat, with 1.470 million tonnes shipped during the first 11 months of the 1996/97 (July/June) season.
Other top destinations for French wheat included-
At a news conference Alain Moulinier, director general of ONIC, also said significant volumes were exported to African, Caribbean and Pacific nations and to Poland.
In its latest supply/demand report for the 1996/97 season ONIC cut its target for soft wheat grain exports to non-EU countries to 6.3 million tonnes from 6.45 million tonnes forecast last month.
Moulinier linked the cut partly to delays in executing oil for food sales to Iraq. He said some 260,000 tonnes of wheat had yet to be shippped to Iraq out of total sales of 625,000 tonnes.
